name_input: Alisha Coils and Transformers A Division Of Cosmo Ferrites Ltd
export_evidence: ImportKey company page for the exact name exists but is a paywalled shell with zero visible rows: "Join ImportKey to view the import and export data records of companies all over the world." No bill-of-lading number, date, destination or HS code was visible. The parent's site states only a claim: "our products are exported to more than 50 countries" (cosmoferrites.com homepage) — a marketing statement, not a shipment record. Source counter: 2 ImportKey pages opened (exact-name slug and 'cosmo-ferrites-ltd' slug), 0 shipment rows actually seen on either; volza, eximpedia, trademo and importyeti all returned HTTP 403/404 and could not be read.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or contract record was retrieved for this entity. Only the parent's own site figures: "300+ Employees  ₹ 1005 Million ($12.50 Million)  3600 MT Installed Capacity" (cosmoferrites.com homepage) — a company self-description, not a supply record. Investor-relations pages returned "Investor relations coming soon" and the annual-report page 404'd, so no revenue split or export/domestic breakdown could be read.
note: Legal entity COSMO FERRITES LIMITED is a real, listed Indian soft-ferrite core manufacturer (plant in the Himalayan region, 3600 MT capacity); 'Alisha Coils and Transformers' is presented as a division of it. HS 850490 (parts of transformers/inductors) is plausible for ferrite cores, though cores are more commonly 8504.90 / 8505-classified — no correction is proposed here because no actual customs line was seen. CRITICAL: no trace of shipments was found for this specific division name in any accessible source — neither export B/L records nor domestic supply records. Per Rule 5 this is recorded as 'следов поставок не найдено' for the division entity, not as 'условно принят'. Export status is 'unknown' rather than 'none_found' only because the trade-data platforms were paywalled/blocked (403/404), so absence could not be positively established. Revenue: null (not public in accessible sources; the ₹1005 Million figure is the parent's own unaudited marketing claim, not a verified turnover). Export volume: null. Recommended next step: pull the parent's BSE/NSE annual report for the segment revenue and export split, and re-check a paid Volza/Eximpedia view for the exact division name.
